settings.settings_source: control, built, derangements, examples, seed, rows, logit_rows, cache_batch, ident_vars: E268's filed values (experiments/kstar_needed/results/predictions.json settings), which E277 and E290 also filed, so every featurization reads each state on the same D, read positions and 256 pairs (eb.check_sources stops the run if any source's settings differ). built_random_of: the five non-random built edits (plan, 'A new size-matched random for each of the 5 non-random built edits'). built_random_seed: the E-number times 1000; rand_<edit> uses built_random_seed + the edit's index in built_random_of. tasks, seeds, trained_random_seed, band: E290's (experiments/ia3_control/results/predictions.json settings): its order of tasks sets its item index and so its random seeds, 161000 + index. sae_err_rows: memory, 64 rows x 41 positions x 16,384 latents x 4 B = 172 MB per encode. sae_chunk: memory, 32 pairs x 41 x 16,384 x 4 B x 2 = 172 MB. repro: one saved item per reused source (E268 VPD built, E290 VPD trained, E277 neurons built, E290 neurons trained) read again through this driver, and E263's SAE x2 over E245's saved K* (the SAE has no saved K). read: what the plan's stage 1 lists (SAE on all 42 states; VPD on seeds 1-2 and copy seed 0, whose E290 VPD value was copied from E275's scaled copy, and the 5 new built randoms; neurons on the 5 new built randoms), cheapest first.
settings.repro_rel_tol_source: TO FILL from the rehearsal (E298 rehearse): per featurization, the relative deviation stage 0 prints for its repro items, rounded up; a stated floor, not a guess (.claude/CLAUDE.md Rules). The VPD and neuron built reproductions re-read K and recompute the write sums (E268 took E247's saved sums), so a deviation comes from K's fragile members and from summation order; n_K_differ beside it says which.

Reproductions: VPD x2 0.7613907 (E268), VPD elicit_s0 0.0273724 (E290), neurons x2 0.9997651 (E277), neurons copy_s0 0.0116811 (E290), SAE x2 over K* 0.9689329 (E263), each to about 1e-6 relative or better
expected.items: VPD built reuse 0.62-0.76 and new and random 0.011-0.019 (E268); neurons with leftovers counted x2 about 0.9998, rebuilt about 0.05, trained 0.012-0.028 and randoms at or under 0.012 (E290 E_b_K); SAE x2 and x10 above 0.9 and rebuilt near 0.13 if K is near K* (E263 over K*); the new built randoms at or under 0.03 at every featurization; trained near its random at every featurization
expected.time: VPD 138-254 s per trained item and 510-1,445 s per built item (E268, E290 on L40S/4090/5090); neurons 59-79 s and 160-1,213 s (E277, E290); SAE unmeasured: its scan runs only the latents that move between x and x', so likely under VPD's time per item; the rehearsal measures it

predictions.rival_a: The old Fig 2's differences between columns came from the set-up (SAE read over K* instead of the needed set K, SAE on the scaled states, VPD on seed 0 only, different randoms and remainder conventions), so at least one block's per-task value (a trained task's mean over its 3 seeds, or a built edit) moves by more than 0.05 from the old figure's value at one featurization when all three read the same states, K rule, randoms and convention
predictions.rival_b: The set-up differences did not matter: every featurization's per-task values stay within 0.05 of the old figure's values for the states both read, and the old order holds (built reuse above built new and randoms at every featurization; trained near its random)
predictions.rule: descriptive, no bar (card): score.py compares each per-task value (headline E_b_K; for the old neuron column, whose plotted field was E_b_K_no_rem, also the like-for-like E_b_K_no_leftover) with results' old figure (writeup-lead's figures/data/definition.csv) and reports the largest move per featurization and block; any move > smallest_gap 0.05 reads rival A, else rival B
